products.title: Winter Bundle: Waterfalls + Redwoods
products.description_html:
Both remaining winter day trips in one purchase, with a guaranteed spot at each: waterfalls in December and redwoods on MLK Day.

Dec. 13 and Jan. 18

Your whole winter season, planned for you and your family — with our signature outings! 💦🐌

We have so much FUN on these adventures — they sell out every year — so this season we're capping numbers and prioritizing families who choose the bundle option first. One purchase here secures your family's spot at both outings below — no need to visit each outing's individual page or buy anything else. Bundle families get priority booking and guaranteed spots, and your family saves compared to booking each one separately.

💦 12/13 — Winter Waterfall Wonderland, Ladybug Love, Leopard-Spotted Banana Slugs + Fungi Hunt (South Bay)
🐌 1/18 — MLK Day: Banana Slug Bonanza, 1,700-Year-Old Redwood + Ancient Ocean Rocks (Peninsula)

✅ WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU BUY:

This is your only checkout — you're done! You do not need to purchase anything on the individual outing pages. Closer to each date, you'll get:

  • digital guide — one for each outing, sent separately as that date approaches.

  • a separate WhatsApp invite for each adventure

  • any adventure-specific details (like the Alice's Restaurant headcount for MLK Day)

WHAT'S INCLUDED IN EACH ADVENTURE

A quick taste of what's ahead — full details for each adventure are on individual listing pages, linked below.

💦 12/13 Winter Waterfall (South Bay): Rushing waterfalls, a fungi hunt, leopard-spotted banana slugs, rock scrambling, a scavenger hunt, and a visit to our Ladybug Christmas Tree (ladybug sightings depend on their migration, but we've seen lots here in past years).

View full listing: Winter Waterfalls, Ladybugs & Banana Slugs

🐌 1/18 MLK Day (Peninsula): A 1,700-year-old redwood giant, banana slugs by the dozens (we found 50+ in previous years!), ancient ocean rocks to explore, a nature scavenger hunt, and an optional meal at the legendary Alice's Restaurant.

View full listing: MLK Day Redwoods, Banana Slugs & Ocean Rocks💦
